jobs.prompt: The MacBook board lists about 30 projects, most of them idle scratch and test checkouts (48 scratch worktrees are registered). Two MacBook-side pieces (the board listing and sorting belong to another lane and are not part of this job). (1) New command swarm forget PATH...: drops dead projects from the machine registry (the registry file that lists linked projects, read by readProjectsRegistry and managed in tools/projects.mjs). REGISTRY ONLY: it never deletes, moves or edits anything inside a project folder (no pointer edit, no hooks removal, no .swarm cleanup, no file writes outside the registry file and its atomic temp file); every run ends with the line registry only: no project files were touched. PATH is resolved with realpath when the folder exists, and matched by the stored path string (normalized) or the project id when the folder is gone; several paths may be given. Options: --dry-run (list what would be forgotten, change nothing), --missing (forget every entry whose folder no longer exists), --scratch (forget every entry for which isScratchRoot from tools/scratch-roots.mjs is true), --yes (needed when a bulk option would forget more than 3 entries; single paths never need it). It refuses to forget the install root itself and says so; an unknown path prints that it is not registered and exits 1; the registry write is atomic (temp file and rename) and safe when two processes forget at once (re-read, remove, write under the existing registry lock if there is one). Forgotten projects come back by themselves the next time swarm runs inside them (existing behavior) and the output says so. Add the command to the CLI dispatch in tools/swarm.mjs (the main CLI function), to the help text, and to the command metadata used by completions (tools/watch-command-meta.mjs and tools/completion.mjs) so tests/completion.test.mjs still passes. (2) Extend isScratchRoot in tools/scratch-roots.mjs (created by the scratch-inbox change, already in the tree) with the owner's rule any tmp or test dirs: a root is also scratch when any path segment of its real path is exactly tmp, temp, test, tests or __tests__ (case-insensitive), except segments that are part of the install root or the user home itself; document the rule in the module header and keep all existing rules. Tests in tests/forget.test.mjs, hermetic (temp install root, temp HOME, temp projects, SWARM_SCRATCH_BASE for scratch, no ambient environment, no network): forgetting one path removes only that entry and leaves every file in the project byte-identical (pointer, source, .swarm); a path whose folder is gone is forgotten by its stored string and by id; --missing; --scratch with the scratch base and a tmp segment path; bulk over 3 entries is refused without --yes and works with it; --dry-run changes nothing; the install root is refused; an unknown path exits 1; other registry entries are untouched and the order is kept; two concurrent forgets both land; output always carries the registry only line; the completion metadata includes forget; isScratchRoot truth table additions for the segment rule (tmp, Test, tests, __tests__, a normal path, a path with a segment testing that must NOT match, the home folder itself). Keep every existing test passing. No token-shaped literals. ignoreTests reason: tests that reference swarm.mjs or projects.mjs in passing are covered by the full suite run before merge.
